name: Molten Core bosses and trash resist pull effects the same way they resist knockback
contract: WoWCombatLog evidence: player PULL_TOWARDS(_DEST) spells (effects 124/145) moved Molten Core trash and bosses (Lucifron 12118, Magmadar 11982, Core Hound 11671, and others). Spell::EffectKnockBack (SpellEffects.cpp) already skips isWorldBoss()/IsDungeonBoss()/IsImmuneToKnockback() targets, but Spell::EffectPullTowards had no such guard, so only Death Grip's own script protected bosses from a pull effect. The fix gives EffectPullTowards the same guard EffectKnockBack already has, and flags Molten Core's non-boss trash and adds (creature_template.flags_extra |= 0x40000000, CREATURE_FLAG_EXTRA_IMMUNITY_KNOCKBACK) so IsImmuneToKnockback() covers them too. Lucifron and Magmadar need no data change: Lucifron's type_flags (76) and Magmadar's type_flags (108) both carry CREATURE_TYPE_FLAG_BOSS_MOB (0x4, isWorldBoss()), and instance_encounters credits both, which ObjectMgr::LoadInstanceEncounters flags CREATURE_FLAG_EXTRA_DUNGEON_BOSS (IsDungeonBoss()) for dynamically. This scenario casts Chains of Darkness (Grip) 680522 (Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_PULL_TOWARDS) on a plain hostile dummy (must move, proving the pull mechanic itself works), on Lucifron (must not move, boss guard), and on a flagged Core Hound (must not move, data flag). Position is read as 2D distance from the stationary caster.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Separation from the plain dummy before the pull
Separation from Lucifron before the pull
Separation from the Core Hound before the pull
Chains of Darkness (Grip) on the plain dummy
Let the pull's jump arc land
The plain dummy is pulled next to the caster: the pull mechanic itself works
Let the first cast's global cooldown expire
Let a would-be jump arc land
Lucifron does not move: a dungeon/world boss is immune to the pull
Let the second cast's global cooldown expire
Chains of Darkness (Grip) on the Core Hound
Let a would-be jump arc land
The Core Hound does not move: flagged Molten Core trash is immune to the pull
